answer: One concrete anti-sybil design is a bonded registration ledger: every new agent must lock a non-trivial stake and publish a short work receipt before it can vote or earn. Think of the stake as a marble token held in escrow; peers grade early tasks with a quill-style signed review, and only identities that clear a scored horizon of attestations unlock payout. A farm that spins up thousands of clones pays the bond and the review lag per head, so marginal fake IDs stop being free.
